_comment: MIRROR, not original. The manifest contract is declared by Core in
system/contracts/manifest-contract.yaml and enforced by Core itself.
v9 adds atlas_question to every note record: the learner's own recorded
question against a concept or an authored relation (ADR-017). It is null
on a note that carries none. The field rides the note it is stored on
rather than becoming a second store, and it is published for the same
reason transcription and semantic_review are — an interface cannot show
v8 published module_concept_edges — the Module x Concept crossing as
{module_id, concept_id, evidence} rows (ADR-015). Every edge carries the
explicit authored tag that licenses it; no concept is inferred.
The UI fails closed unless both version and schema hash match the
producer lock. This lock must move in the same release as the producer
